# Skills

This page describes the skill pack that teaches agents the Tlilli turn, one section per skill, built from the sources under `skills/`.

The pack has no skills yet. The first ones, `tlilli-run`, `tlilli-revise` and `tlilli-stub`, arrive with v0.2 ([PRD 11](../prd/11-fr-v0.2-red-ink.md)).
